note: Curated facilitator relayer sets that x402scan's source does NOT carry, added so the x402-scoping isn't blind to real facilitators. Each entry cites an authoritative source. build_relayer_registry.py merges these into the generated registry; registry_check.py excludes them from the x402scan drift diff (x402scan not listing them is expected, not drift).

polygon-facilitator._provenance: Polygon Labs' official x402 Facilitator (x402.polygon.technology). Documented rotating relayer pool of 24 keys (x402_1/x402_2/x402_3, 8 each). Confirmed on-chain: all 24 appear as tx.from on Polygon USDC transferWithAuthorization, and Polygonscan name-tags them 'x402 Facilitator'. x402scan's facilitator source omits this operator, which is why our x402scan-derived Polygon set (corbits/thirdweb/x402rs, 3 addrs) was near-dormant and scoped Polygon x402 to 0.

unattributed-base-25e9._provenance: merona-DISCOVERED via facilitator-watch (EVM leads-to-review, 2026-08-10), NOT operator-declared. On-chain behavioral evidence only: unlabeled EOA (no Basescan name tag), relays EIP-3009 (tx.from = this address, distinct from the EIP-3009 authorizer) across 700 distinct sellers on Base. PAYER-DIVERSITY VERIFIED pre-admission (DB query 2026-08-10): 5,459 settlements, 4,646 DISTINCT PAYERS, 700 sellers, 0 self-pay — a many-buyers-to-many-sellers marketplace, which rules out the prober/disperser pattern (a prober shows ~1 payer; merona's own delivery sweep is that shape). Contrast the two bundlers rejected the same day (0x211d.../0xe196..., Etherscan/Basescan-tagged 'ERC-4337 Bundler', 9-11 sellers). Operator unknown — attributed as 'unattributed-base' pending identification; admitted on breadth + relay pattern + payer diversity, not on a documented source.
